Hi Kenji, Priya, Liam —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood. I know coordinating across JST / SGT / AEST can be painful, so I pulled a few 30‑minute windows that should hit reasonable business hours in each city without spilling into the next local day. All times below include local conversions and UTC for your calendar system:

Option A: 2026-10-13 09:00 JST / 08:00 SGT / 10:00 AEST (UTC+09:00 / UTC+08:00 / UTC+10:00)
Option B: 2026-10-13 16:30 JST / 15:30 SGT / 17:30 AEST
Option C: 2026-10-14 07:30 JST / 06:30 SGT / 08:30 AEST (early morning for SYD)

I've attached a quick .ics with those slots (proposed_slots.ics) — please let me know which one works or if you prefer a different local time. If your calendars show the invite on the previous/next day, call that out and we'll reissue in the correct timezone.

Agenda: 1) Quick product walkthrough (10m) 2) Short Q&A on privacy/compliance (10m) 3) Next steps and pilot options (10m)

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

—

Kenji — good catch and sorry for the confusion. The .ics generator I used encoded Option A as UTC 00:00 on 2026-10-12 which is why some calendars show the previous day in local time. That was user error on my side.

Action plan:
- I'll reissue the invite with explicit local-time DTSTART/DTEND and the UTC timestamp aligned for 2026-10-13 09:00 JST (which is 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z).
- I attached a quick timezone reference image (timezone-reference.png) showing the local labels and the DST status across the three cities.
- If everyone confirms Option A, I'll send the corrected invite; if any participant prefers Option B, say so and I'll pivot.

Vivek / Mina / Soojin — FYI: we should confirm the sched tool we use doesn't strip TZ labels when generating .ics for APAC prospects. If we can't rely on the vendor tool, I'll send manual ICS with explicit TZ blocks.

Thanks —
Kimberly

Kimberly — thanks for flagging. One quick note: Australia transitions for DST in early October depending on state; NSW (Sydney) moved last week so AEST is currently AEDT (UTC+11) for our target date. That means Option A local conversions become: 09:00 JST / 08:00 SGT / 11:00 AEDT (not 10:00).

I'll sanity-check the invite generator and, if needed, produce an ICS using tzid:Asia/Tokyo and tzid:Australia/Sydney blocks so clients' calendars honor local DST.

— Vivek
